title: Guidelines and Evaluation of Clinical Explainable AI in Medical Image Analysis
reasoning: The paper is motivated by the ethical implications of using AI in high-stakes clinical settings and mentions 'ethical and legal requirements'. However, its core contribution is a set of technical and usability guidelines (e.g., Truthfulness, Plausibility, Efficiency) for evaluating Explainable AI (XAI) systems. It does not engage in the evaluation or benchmarking of ethical frameworks, moral principles, or religious concepts themselves. The focus is on the technical performance and clinical viability of XAI methods, not a direct assessment of ethics.
